name: Pop Zine
tagline: Y2K riso zine: hot-pink punch words, halftone navy, sunbursts, a rolling counter and hard cuts.
description: Loud, printed-paper style for podcasts, explainers and launch-day countdowns. Cream grainy paper and dusty navy halftone panels, huge condensed hot-pink words with a navy outline, a spinning pink-and-cream sunburst, a mechanical LCD digit counter, a dotted chart that draws, and persistent HUD cards (a P(SUCCESS) percentage chip and a LIVE date stamp) that update on every hard cut.

display.usage: Punch words 150–340px, all caps, #ff4f9a with a 4px navy outline and a 12px hard navy offset shadow; percentages 78px

body.usage: Captions 46px in a dark navy pill bottom-left, first word underlined in pink; kickers 54px tracked 0.3em

mono.usage: LIVE stamp, dates, chart labels and LCD headers 28–56px

digits.usage: Mechanical counter digits 168px in cream windows

transitions: hard cuts only, every 1.2–1.6s, alternating cream paper / navy halftone / pink sunburst
persistent chip and LIVE stamp stay on top and update their value on each cut with a scale pop
textAnimations: punch words: scale 1.3 + rotation -4° → rest in 0.3s expo.out, 0.1–0.18s stagger per word
caption pill rises 40px in 0.22s right after the cut
counter digits roll on vertical strips, each stopping 0.22s after the previous one
OUT NOW stamp slams from scale 1.8 with power4.in

rhythm.notes: Six hard-cut scenes in 8s. Each cut = new background, one punch phrase or one graphic (disc, counter, chart), a new caption, and an updated percentage/date. Something rotates or rolls in every shot.

guide:
- Alternate three grounds on hard cuts: cream paper #efe6d2, navy #34417a with a 9px halftone dot pattern and soft mottling, and a slowly rotating repeating-conic sunburst (#ff6fae / #f3e7d0, 9° rays). Lay a multiply feTurbulence grain over everything (~30%).
- Punch words are Anton all caps, 150–340px, #ff4f9a with a 4px #2e3a6b outline (8 text-shadows) plus a 12px hard navy offset. One to three words per scene, each word punching in from scale 1.3 / -4°.
- Keep two HUD cards on top the whole time: a cream 'P(SUCCESS)' chip top-left with an #f0582a Anton percentage that climbs each scene, and a 'LIVE' stamp top-right with a ticking clock and a date that changes per cut. Cards are cream #f3ead6 with a 3px navy border, a hard 7px shadow and a 1–2° tilt.
- Captions live in a #232b52 pill bottom-left (Space Grotesk 600, 46px, cream), first word underlined in pink. One short sentence per scene.
- Data moments are physical: a mechanical LCD counter (pink header bar, navy screen, cream Silkscreen digit windows that roll and stop left to right) or a dotted line chart (stroke-dasharray '0 28', round caps) revealed by a mask wipe with pink points popping.
- Finish on a sunburst end card with the show title, a navy episode pill and a red rubber-stamp 'OUT NOW'. No fades, no gradients on type, no characters or photos.
